features.name: Otherworldly Patron
features.summary: Choose a patron (Archfey, Fiend, or Great Old One); it grants features at 1st, 6th, 10th, and 14th level and an expanded spell list.

features.name: Pact Magic
features.summary: Charisma-based casting from the warlock list. Few slots, all cast at the table's Slot Level; every slot returns on a short or long rest. Spells known can be swapped on level-up; arcane focus allowed.

features.name: Eldritch Invocations
features.summary: Learn two invocations at 2nd level, more per the Invocations Known column; on each warlock level-up one known invocation may be replaced with another you qualify for.

features.name: Pact Boon
features.summary: Your patron grants one boon of your choice: Pact of the Chain, Pact of the Blade, or Pact of the Tome.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.summary: At 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level raise one ability by 2 or two abilities by 1 (max 20).

features.name: Mystic Arcanum (6th level)
features.summary: Pick one 6th-level warlock spell as an arcanum; cast it once without using a spell slot, regaining the use on a long rest. Granted first at 11th level.

features.name: Mystic Arcanum (7th level)
features.summary: Pick one 7th-level warlock spell as an arcanum; cast it once without using a spell slot, regaining the use on a long rest.

features.name: Mystic Arcanum (8th level)
features.summary: Pick one 8th-level warlock spell as an arcanum; cast it once without using a spell slot, regaining the use on a long rest.

features.name: Mystic Arcanum (9th level)
features.summary: Pick one 9th-level warlock spell as an arcanum; cast it once without using a spell slot, regaining the use on a long rest.

features.name: Eldritch Master
features.summary: Spend 1 minute pleading with your patron to recover every expended Pact Magic slot; usable once per long rest.

choices.name: Agonizing Blast
choices.summary: Add your Charisma modifier to the damage of each eldritch blast hit.

choices.name: Armor of Shadows
choices.summary: Cast mage armor on yourself at will with no slot or material components.

choices.name: Ascendant Step
choices.summary: Cast levitate on yourself at will with no slot or material components.

choices.name: Beast Speech
choices.summary: Cast speak with animals at will without a spell slot.

choices.name: Beguiling Influence
choices.summary: Gain proficiency in Deception and Persuasion.

choices.name: Bewitching Whispers
choices.summary: Cast compulsion once with a warlock slot; regain on a long rest.

choices.name: Book of Ancient Secrets
choices.summary: Add two 1st-level ritual spells from any class to your Book of Shadows and cast them as rituals; copy more rituals up to half your warlock level (rounded up) at 2 hours and 50 gp per spell level. Also cast known warlock rituals as rituals.

choices.name: Chains of Carceri
choices.summary: Cast hold monster at will on a celestial, fiend, or elemental with no slot or material components; once per creature per long rest.
choices.prerequisite: 15th level, Pact of the Chain feature

choices.name: Devil's Sight
choices.summary: See normally in magical and nonmagical darkness out to 120 feet.

choices.name: Dreadful Word
choices.summary: Cast confusion once with a warlock slot; regain on a long rest.

choices.name: Eldritch Sight
choices.summary: Cast detect magic at will without a spell slot.

choices.name: Eldritch Spear
choices.summary: Eldritch blast's range becomes 300 feet.

choices.name: Eyes of the Rune Keeper
choices.summary: You can read any writing.

choices.name: Fiendish Vigor
choices.summary: Cast false life on yourself at will as a 1st-level spell, with no slot or material components.

choices.name: Gaze of Two Minds
choices.summary: Action: touch a willing humanoid and use its senses until the end of your next turn (extendable each turn with an action while on the same plane); you are blind and deaf to your own surroundings meanwhile.

choices.name: Lifedrinker
choices.summary: Pact weapon hits deal extra necrotic damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1).
choices.prerequisite: 12th level, Pact of the Blade feature

choices.name: Mask of Many Faces
choices.summary: Cast disguise self at will without a spell slot.

choices.name: Master of Myriad Forms
choices.summary: Cast alter self at will without a spell slot.

choices.name: Minions of Chaos
choices.summary: Cast conjure elemental once with a warlock slot; regain on a long rest.

choices.name: Mire the Mind
choices.summary: Cast slow once with a warlock slot; regain on a long rest.

choices.name: Misty Visions
choices.summary: Cast silent image at will with no slot or material components.

choices.name: One with Shadows
choices.summary: In dim light or darkness, use an action to turn invisible until you move or take an action or reaction.

choices.name: Otherworldly Leap
choices.summary: Cast jump on yourself at will with no slot or material components.

choices.name: Repelling Blast
choices.summary: Each eldritch blast hit can shove the target up to 10 feet straight away from you.

choices.name: Sculptor of Flesh
choices.summary: Cast polymorph once with a warlock slot; regain on a long rest.

choices.name: Sign of Ill Omen
choices.summary: Cast bestow curse once with a warlock slot; regain on a long rest.

choices.name: Thief of Five Fates
choices.summary: Cast bane once with a warlock slot; regain on a long rest.

choices.name: Thirsting Blade
choices.summary: Attack twice with your pact weapon when you take the Attack action.
choices.prerequisite: 5th level, Pact of the Blade feature

choices.name: Visions of Distant Realms
choices.summary: Cast arcane eye at will without a spell slot.

choices.name: Voice of the Chain Master
choices.summary: Communicate telepathically with your familiar, perceive through its senses, and speak through it in your own voice while on the same plane.

choices.name: Whispers of the Grave
choices.summary: Cast speak with dead at will without a spell slot.

choices.name: Witch Sight
choices.summary: See the true form of shapechangers and of creatures hidden by illusion or transmutation magic within 30 feet and in line of sight.

choices.name: Pact of the Chain
choices.summary: Learn find familiar, cast as a ritual and not counted against spells known; familiar may also be an imp, pseudodragon, quasit, or sprite, and can make one attack when you forgo one of yours during the Attack action.

choices.name: Pact of the Blade
choices.summary: Action: summon a melee pact weapon of any form, proficient and magical for overcoming resistance. Can bind one magic weapon (non-artifact, non-sentient) via a 1-hour ritual to summon instead. Vanishes if more than 5 ft away for 1 minute.

choices.name: Pact of the Tome
choices.summary: Receive a Book of Shadows holding three cantrips from any class list, castable at will while you carry it and not counted against cantrips known; a lost book can be replaced with a 1-hour ceremony.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.summary: The Archfey adds its expanded spells (see spells) to the warlock list for you when you learn warlock spells.

features.name: Fey Presence
features.summary: Action: every creature in a 10-foot cube from you makes a Wisdom save vs your spell DC or is charmed or frightened (your pick) until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Misty Escape
features.summary: Reaction when you take damage: become invisible and teleport up to 60 feet to a visible spot; invisibility lasts until your next turn starts or you attack or cast.

features.name: Beguiling Defenses
features.summary: Immune to being charmed; when someone tries to charm you, your reaction can force a Wisdom save or that creature is charmed by you for 1 minute or until damaged.

features.name: Dark Delirium
features.summary: Action: a creature within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save or is charmed or frightened for up to 1 minute (concentration), lost in an illusory realm; ends if it takes damage.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.summary: The Fiend adds its expanded spells (see spells) to the warlock list for you when you learn warlock spells.

features.name: Dark One's Blessing
features.summary: When you drop a hostile creature to 0 HP, gain temporary HP equal to Charisma modifier + warlock level (minimum 1).

features.name: Dark One's Own Luck
features.summary: Add a d10 to an ability check or saving throw after seeing the roll but before its effects apply.

features.name: Fiendish Resilience
features.summary: After a short or long rest pick a damage type to resist until you pick another; magical and silvered weapon damage bypasses it.

features.name: Hurl Through Hell
features.summary: On a hit, banish the target through the lower planes until the end of your next turn; when it returns, a non-fiend takes 10d10 psychic damage.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.summary: The Great Old One adds its expanded spells (see spells) to the warlock list for you when you learn warlock spells.

features.name: Awakened Mind
features.summary: Speak telepathically with any creature within 30 feet that knows at least one language, no shared language required.

features.name: Entropic Ward
features.summary: Reaction: impose disadvantage on an attack roll against you; if it misses, you have advantage on your next attack against that creature before the end of your next turn.

features.name: Thought Shield
features.summary: Your mind can't be read unless you allow it; resistance to psychic damage, and creatures that deal psychic damage to you take the same amount.

features.name: Create Thrall
features.summary: Action: touch an incapacitated humanoid to charm it until remove curse, the charm ends, or you use this again; you can talk to it telepathically on the same plane.

discrepancies: Invocations Known column wrong at two levels: app has 3 at 4th level (PHB: 2) and 4 at 6th level (PHB: 3). All other levels match (PHB: -,2,2,2,3,3,4,4,5,5,5,6,6,6,7,7,7,8,8,8).

No Eldritch Invocation options exist anywhere in the app: all 32 PHB invocations (with prerequisites such as eldritch blast cantrip, 5th/7th/9th/12th/15th level, Pact of the Chain/Blade/Tome) are missing, so a player cannot pick invocations.

No Pact Boon choices in the app: Pact of the Chain, Pact of the Blade, and Pact of the Tome are absent; the 'Pact Boon' feature desc stops at 'gain one of the following features of your choice' with nothing following.
PHB patron 'archfey' (The Archfey) has no features in the app: missing Expanded Spell List (1), Fey Presence (1), Misty Escape (6), Beguiling Defenses (10), Dark Delirium (14).
PHB patron 'great-old-one' (The Great Old One) has no features in the app: missing Expanded Spell List (1), Awakened Mind (1), Entropic Ward (6), Thought Shield (10), Create Thrall (14).

No patron has its expanded spell list: Fiend, Archfey, and Great Old One spell lists (two spells each for spell levels 1-5) are absent; the Fiend subclass also lacks an 'Expanded Spell List' feature entry.

Limited-use resources are not modelled as features/resources: Pact Magic slots recharge on a short rest (Pact Magic desc is truncated and never says so), Eldritch Master (1/long rest), Fey Presence/Misty Escape/Dark Delirium/Dark One's Own Luck/Entropic Ward (1/short rest), Hurl Through Hell (1/long rest). Mystic Arcanum uses are only tracked as 0/1 counters in progression.special.
Otherworldly Patron feature desc names only the Fiend ('such as the Fiend'); the PHB offers Archfey, Fiend, and Great Old One.

Matches the PHB: hit die d8, saves Wis/Cha, Light Armor + Simple Weapons, no tools, 2 skills from Arcana/Deception/History/Intimidation/Investigation/Nature/Religion, Charisma casting, patron at 1st level, cantrips known, spells known, slot count and slot level (encoded by slot position) at all 20 levels, and all class feature levels.
